newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down before IMF bailout package.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down before IMF bailout package.

text.p: Thai stocks would likely take a cautious retreat in early Monday trade on the eve of a scheduled announcement of an IMF economic bailout package, brokers said.
"I think the market would be sluggish. Most investors are waiting for the rescue package proposed by the IMF," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.
The composite SET index closed 13.58 points lower at 652.04 on thin 3.5 billion baht turnover on Friday.
Thai economic ministers are holding a meeting to review the proposed package being worked out of Thai and and IMF officials.
A final agreement is expected to be submitted for cabinet approval on Tuesday.
